arithmetic: For nonnegative B and gasUsed>=0, below-target decrement is floor(B*(target-used)/target/8)<=floor(B/8), so childB>=B-floor(B/8). Exact same-parent child formula may strengthen this lower bound. Both transaction costs are lower bounds; route input cost and all extra costs are ignored.
domain_clarification: Selected-source model only: a standalone conventional type2 transaction under the stated EIP1559/EIP7623 formulas, with caller bearing its total gas and standard WETH/ETH one-for-one accounting. No proof of active fork rules or consensus header validity. EIP7623 mentions exceptions to its calldata-floor validity discussion; no universal bound over alternate transaction/account-abstraction/authorization/subsidy/amortized routes is inferred. Intrinsic upfront gas alone would not justify a fee floor without handling refunds.
implementation: Use unbounded integer arithmetic. Read only already pinned full parent/final headers, conditional child and reported stock. Confirm header fee/gas fields agree between first/final returned parent before applying the bound. No new API/RPC/quote,source body cache or threshold change. Any unsupported source-model domain yields conditional/unavailable interpretation, not a universal trading rejection.

primary_sources.support: Base fee payment; parent target gasLimit//2; integer adjustment denominator8; upward adjustment has minimum1.

For the conventional transaction model, final gasUsed formula is21000 plus maximum of refund-adjusted execution/data cost and nonnegative calldata floor. This supports the21000 lower bound after ordinary execution refunds.
